summary: Kernel 7.3.3, BIND DNS security fixes (CVE-2026-94300, CVE-2026-97313, CVE-2026-96888, CVE-2026-19630), module metadata library security fixes, and NSS bug fixes.

changes.description: Libraries used by the BIND DNS packages
changes.note:
## Security Fixes:

- [CVE-2026-94300](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-94300) Fix remote termination of named under concurrent GSS-TSIG traffic (rhbz#2558420)
- [CVE-2026-97313](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-97313) Fix a bug when resuming from a query initiated by RPZ (rhbz#2558427)
- [CVE-2026-96888](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-96888) Possible crash with redirect and qname-minimization strict (rhbz#2558424)
- [CVE-2026-19630](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-19630) Crafted DNS messages could exhaust CPU while being parsed (rhbz#2558488)

This release rejects YAML files which decompress to much (CVE-2026-92823), rejects YAML documents with YAML tree deeper than 64 (CVE-2026-92822), fixes iterating over checksums in modulemd_module_stream_v2_emit_rpm_map() function (CVE-2026-92824).

NSS Release Notes

Update NSS to 3.133.0

- Bug 1989541 - Use FIPS-aware key extraction in the PBKDF2 long password test.
- Bug 2039884 - Use vectorized Hacl_Chacha20Poly1305_128 on aarch64 above 512 bytes.
- Bug 2046805 - Add SSL_EnablePlaintextResumptionExport experimental API.
- Bug 2082027 - reorder session context setup in sftk_doMACInit.
- Bug 2082077 - Initialize sftk_MACCtx in sftk_MAC_Init.
- Bug 2082792 - Keep DTLS handshake messages whole in the send buffer.
- Bug 2082793 - Don't cache sessions when ECH was rejected.
- Bug 2083840 - Move CLAUDE.md into AGENTS.md.
- Bug 2084251 - Fix cf_status_nss clearing base-release bugs on point releases.
- Bug 2085776 - signver: Exit with 0 after a successful -A.
- Bug 2085825 - harden release assertion in sftk_DestroySessionObjectData.
- Bug 2086058 - Reject not empty parameters in ML-KEM && ML-DSA AlgorithmIdentifiers.
- Bug 2087641 - Harden inline attribute value handling in softoken.

https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_133.html
